    • MEXC VS Bitget Fees
    • MEXC VS Bybit Fees

What Are MEXC’s Fees?

MEXC fees are the direct charges you pay to the exchange whenever you trade, withdraw funds, or use special features on the platform. Currently, MEXC’s fees cover five main areas: spot trading, futures trading, deposits and withdrawals, token listings, and newer products like RealStocks and tokenized stocks.

Overview of MEXC’s Fees

MEXC’s overall fee schedule is a straightforward fee structure with low fees, and the table below lays out every category at a glance:

Fee TypeStandard RateNotes
Spot Maker0%Applies to nearly all trading pairs
Spot Taker0.05%20% off with MX discount
Futures Maker0%Applies to nearly all pairs in most regions
Futures Taker0.02%Increases up to 0.1% depending on region
Crypto DepositFreeYou only cover the network gas fee
Fiat DepositFree from MEXCThird-party processors and e wallets may charge extra fees outside MEXC
Crypto WithdrawalVaries by coin/networkFlat fee, not a percentage
RealStocks Trading0% (promotion)Covers 7,000+ US stocks and ETFs
Token ListingNo fixed public feeReal cost often runs in the thousands of dollars

Note: You should keep in mind that these numbers can vary a bit depending on your account tier, your region, and whatever promotion MEXC is running that month.

Spot Trading Fees

Spot trading on MEXC comes with a permanent 0% maker fee and a taker fee of 0.05% for the standard account tier. You see, that taker rate is already half of what Binance and Bitget charge on their base plan, so spot traders save money from the very first trade. There is also an MX Deduction feature that gives a flat 20% discount when you pay fees directly in MX.

Tip: A maker order rests on the book and waits to get filled, while taker orders or market orders execute immediately against someone else’s order.

Example:Let’s say you place a $100,000 market order. Now, that counts as a taker order, so you pay $50 in trading costs. But if you place the same order as a limit order instead of an instant market order that waits in the book, you pay nothing at all.

MEXC Futures Trading Fees

MEXC futures fees are 0% for makers and 0.02% for takers on standard USDT-margined perpetual contracts. This competitive pricing is a core part of MEXC’s fee structure, and that taker rate runs well below the industry average, which usually lands somewhere around 0.05% to 0.06% on other big exchanges. Now, similar to the spot market, you can also get a 20% discount with the MX token.

Note: Also, some users may see a different number based on their account tier and region. Actually, MEXC has applied rates of 0.01% maker and 0.04% taker to selected users and regions, and active traders can join the VVIP program for reduced fees.

MEXC even charges separate fees for futures API trading, and they are somewhat higher. Currently, API trading on MEXC futures will cost you a 0.04% maker and 0.06% taker fee.

You will also pay a funding fee every 8 hours while trading futures contracts. The funding rate is a periodic payment exchanged directly between long and short traders in perpetual futures markets to keep contract prices aligned with spot prices, so mexc futures fees can also include this cost on perpetual contracts. Put simply, funding is the market paying itself, not a fee MEXC keeps. These rates are generally between 0.01%-0.03%, subject to change. Leverage, margin, and position size directly affect futures trading risks and overall profit potential.

MEXC Deposit Fees

MEXC charges zero deposit fees for all cryptocurrencies deposited into your account. You can easily transfer USDT, Bitcoin, Ethereum, or any other supported token into MEXC without paying any platform surcharge. Generally, you only pay the standard network fee charged by your external sending wallet or the sending exchange.

Now, for fiat deposits, bank transfers, cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, e-wallets, and outside payment firms may show a provider charge, but MEXC does not charge any fees.

  • Bank Transfers (e.g., SEPA): MEXC charges 0% platform fees for direct regional bank transfers, but your personal bank may charge standard cross-border or wire fees.
  • Credit and Debit Cards / Instant Buy: MEXC applies 0% service fees for card purchases, but again, third-party processing gateways (like MoonPay, Banxa, or Mercuryo) or card issuers can easily tack on processing or foreign exchange charges ranging from 2% to 4%; these are external charges, not MEXC’s own fee structure.
  • P2P Trading: Peer-to-peer fiat transactions via supported local payment methods carry 0 fees charged by MEXC.

This is platform cost information only, not financial or investment advice.

MEXC Withdrawal Fees

MEXC charges a fixed withdrawal fee based on the coin and blockchain network you select. Withdrawal fees vary by coin and selected blockchain network. MEXC will show you the exact fee and the amount you will receive before you confirm the transfer.

MEXC Withdrawal Fees by Coin & Network (subject to change):

CoinNetwork / StandardTypical Withdrawal Fee
USDT (Tether)BNB Smart Chain (BEP20) Arbitrum One Solana (SOL) TRON (TRC20) Ethereum (ERC20)0.01 USDT 0.05 USDT 0.18 USDT 1.00 USDT ~0.094 – 1.00 USDT
BTC (Bitcoin)Bitcoin Native (SegWit/Taproot) BNB Smart Chain (BEP20)~0.0002 – 0.0003 BTC ~0.00000025 BTC
ETH (Ethereum)Arbitrum One Base Optimism (OP) Ethereum (ERC20)~0.00000084 ETH ~0.0000013 ETH ~0.0000024 ETH ~0.0000013 – 0.000029 ETH
SOL (Solana)Solana Mainnet~0.000037 SOL

Note: Internal transfers to another MEXC user’s address are completely free and normally arrive faster because they do not need an on-chain transfer.

What Are the MEXC Withdrawal Limits?

MEXC’s 24-hour withdrawal limits are 10 BTC with no KYC, 80 BTC with Primary KYC, 200 BTC with Advanced KYC, and 400 BTC for an institutional account. Now, these are mostly maximum account limits, not a promise that every user can withdraw that amount at any time.

Verification levelPublished 24-hour withdrawal limit
No KYC10 BTC
Primary KYC80 BTC
Advanced KYC200 BTC
Institutional KYC400 BTC

Note: Some countries have a much lower limit for unverified accounts (up to $1,000 per day), and even nowadays, some regions have mandatory KYC. So, you must verify your limits under your account settings.

MEXC RealStocks Trading Fees

MEXC charges 0% commission on RealStocks trading right now, as part of an ongoing promotion with no announced end date. 

RealStocks lets you buy actual shares of more than 7,000 US-listed stocks and ETFs using USDT. MEXC also offers Stock Futures and separate tokenized stock products, and both of those have carried zero trading fees during recent promotional events too.

MEXC Listing Fee

MEXC does not publish one fixed fee for listing a new crypto token. Its public listing form asks a project to submit its team, token, funding, market, and security details for review, but it does not show a standard price that every project can pay.

The listing fee is not a cost for a normal trader buying a listed coin. It concerns the token team that wants MEXC to add its asset.

How Do Maker and Taker Orders Affect Trading Rates?

Maker and taker orders determine whether you pay a 0% fee or a standard rate because of how they provide or remove liquidity from the order book.

A maker order adds liquidity to the exchange book. You need to create a maker order by placing a limit order at a price that does not fill right away, like placing a buy order below the current market price. MEXC rewards you with a 0% maker fee because you help the market grow deeper.

A taker order removes liquidity instantly, and taker fees apply when a marketable order removes liquidity immediately. Now, you can become a taker when you use a market order or a limit order that matches an existing listing immediately. Traders use market orders when they want to buy or sell right away at the best available price. MEXC charges a small taker fee (0.05% spot, 0.02% futures) to process that instant trade.

How to Reduce MEXC Fees?

You can reduce your MEXC fees through several trading options for lowering overall trading costs, including registering with a MEXC referral code “mexc-bestbonus”, using limit orders (Maker Orders), holding MX tokens for automatic fee deductions, and trading zero-fee promotion pairs.

Using MEXC Referral Code

The MEXC referral code “mexc-bestbonus” gives you a 10% discount on eligible trading fees for a qualifying new account. You need to enter the code in the referral field during sign-up and confirm that the rate appears in your account. The discount only applies where MEXC charges a fee, so a 0% maker order stays at 0%.

OrderNormal feeFee after a 10% discountCost on $10,000
Spot maker0%0%$0
Spot taker0.05%0.045%$5 becomes $4.5
Futures maker0%0%$0
Futures taker0.02%0.018%$2 becomes $1.8

Use Limit Orders (Maker Orders)

“Post-Only” limit orders can easily cut the normal MEXC maker fee to 0% and stop the order from becoming a taker. You must choose a price that does not fill at once. So, we would say to enable the “Post-Only” order type and let the order sit in the book until another trader matches it.

Now, the catch is that a limit order might not fill if the market moves away from your price before someone matches it. Hence, for anyone not in a rush, though, this single habit is probably the easiest way to trade for free on MEXC.

Hold MX Tokens

You can buy some MX tokens directly in the spot market and turn on the “Deduct using MX” toggle inside your account settings. The platform then automatically deducts your trading fees from your MX balance at a 20% reduced rate. For futures discounts, you may also need to move MX into your futures wallet and enable fee deduction separately for that account.

Note: MEXC temporarily suspended the old MX Holder Discount (the 50% trading fee reduction for holding 500 MX or more). So, you won’t get that discount, but still, you can get the 20% trading fee discount when choosing to pay fees via MX deduction.

Trade Zero-Fee Promotion Pairs

Trading on MEXC’s eligible promotion pairs can mean zero fee trading with 0% on both maker and taker orders for that specific coin, with no MX or referral code needed.

MEXC rotates these promotions across popular pairs like BTC, ETH, XRP, and DOGE, and a campaign may apply to a specific trading pair or selected futures pairs; in some cases, it offers zero fees on one side or both sides. Also, the RealStocks and Stock Futures products have carried similar zero-fee windows during recent events too. You can check the MEXC announcement page or fee dashboard to see which pairs currently have active 0-fee promotions, and confirm whether taker fees or waived pricing applies during the current promotion.

How MEXC Fees Compare to Other Exchanges

MEXC has competitive fees versus Binance, Bitget, and Bybit for standard users, with lower base trading fees in most like-for-like trades. The comparison below uses standard rates and does not count short offers, VIP tiers, referral deals, or native-token discounts.

ExchangeSpot makerSpot takerFutures makerFutures takerNative Token Discount
MEXC0%0.05%0%0.02%Up to 20% (MX token)
Binance0.10%0.10%0.02%0.05%Up to 25% (BNB token)
Bitget0.10%0.10%0.02%0.06%Up to 20% (BGB token)

MEXC VS Binance Fees

CryptoGames has marked its 12th anniversary as a cryptocurrency gambling platform. To commemorate twelve continuous years of operation in the fast-evolving iGaming space, the casino recently hosted an action-packed, week-long anniversary celebration packed with exclusive player incentives, reduced margins, and community giveaways.

CryptoGames 12th Anniversary Promotions 

CryptoGames marked its 12 years of operation with several temporary promotions for registered users. Throughout the anniversary week, registered members enjoyed a suite of celebratory promotions:

  • Halved House Edge on Dice: During the anniversary promotion, CryptoGames reduced the house edge on its Dice game from 1.0% to 0.5%. 
  • Site-Wide Voucher Drops: Bonus vouchers were distributed through chat rooms, community channels, and player emails.

  • Interactive Community Games: Daily chat-based competitions and trivia challenges offered cryptocurrency prizes to participating users. 

CryptoGames In-House Games and Provably Fair System 

Established with a philosophy centered on mathematical transparency, simplicity, and low house edges, CryptoGames stands out by offering 10 fully in-house, custom-built games rather than third-party reskins. According to CryptoGames, its games use provably fair mechanisms based on server seeds, client seeds, and nonces, which allow users to verify individual game outcomes.

title: XRP Price Prediction: 13-Month Cycle Signals Potential Bottom as Weekly EMA Points to Rally Beyond $1.54
summary: XRP is approaching a key technical juncture after a sharp recovery in August gave way to renewed consolidation around the $1.35-$1.40 region.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: XRP

XRP is approaching a key technical juncture after a sharp recovery in August gave way to renewed consolidation around the $1.35-$1.40 region.

Several analysts are now watching whether the XRP price can establish a sustainable base above its recent lows, while longer-term cycle analysis points to the possibility of a broader recovery.

At the center of the bullish case is a 13-month cycle identified by TradingView analyst Fractical. The analysis suggests XRP’s latest bearish swing low occurred close to the latest cycle marker, potentially completing the bottoming phase of the pattern. If the cycle continues to follow its previous rhythm, the analyst expects a five-wave advance that could develop over roughly the next 13 months.

That view remains technical rather than fundamental. The price still faces important resistance near $1.40, while shorter-term momentum indicators show that buyers have yet to establish decisive control.

XRP Price Tests a Key Technical Zone

The XRP price. has been trading near $1.35-$1.36 in early September after retreating from a recent recovery high around $1.70. The pullback has brought the price back toward a region where several short- and medium-term technical levels converge.

XRP is at a key decision point as its 4H chart forms a tightening symmetrical triangle, with $1.40 marking the critical breakout level. Source: @TheMoonHailey via X

A recent analysis from @TheMoonHailey identified a symmetrical triangle on XRP’s four-hour chart. The analyst described $1.40 as the key breakout level, with a move above it potentially opening the way toward $1.45 and then $1.55.

Conversely, a failure to hold the lower portion of the formation could expose XRP to levels around $1.34 and $1.28.

The setup is important because XRP is trading close to the triangle’s apex, where narrowing price action can precede a larger directional move. However, a compressed range by itself does not determine which direction the eventual breakout will take.

Recent market action also shows why $1.40 remains significant. The price has repeatedly struggled to sustain advances through that area, keeping the immediate XRP price prediction dependent on whether buyers can convert resistance into support.

13-Month Cycle Points to a Potential Bottom

Longer-term cycle analysis provides a more constructive interpretation of the current consolidation.

TradingView analyst Fractical recently published a chart built around an approximately 13-month cycle in XRP. The analyst said the chart had originally been prepared in February but was published only after the latest market move developed.

The analyst expects XRP’s latest bearish swing low to mark a cycle bottom, with a five-wave impulsive rally potentially unfolding over the next 13 months. Source: Fractical on TradingView

According to the analysis, major highs and lows have historically occurred close to the cycle markers, often just before or slightly after them. The latest bearish swing low also ended shortly before the most recent marker.

Fractical, therefore, considers the bottoming structure complete and is looking for a five-wave impulsive advance during the new cycle.

The analyst’s thesis is effectively that the price has moved through a corrective phase and could now begin a larger upward sequence. Under that interpretation, the next major advance would not necessarily occur in a straight line. Instead, it could develop through successive impulse and corrective waves over an extended period.

Such cycle-based analysis should be treated cautiously. Historical timing relationships can provide context, but they do not guarantee that future market turning points will occur on schedule. The proposed Elliott Wave structure can also change as new price data emerges.

Weekly EMA Sets $1.54 XRP Price Target

Shorter-term moving averages currently provide a more immediate test for the bullish thesis.

ChartNerdTA recently highlighted a four-hour death cross followed by a bearish retest, putting pressure on XRP’s near-term structure. The analyst identified the $1.31-$1.32 area around the daily 20 EMA as an important support zone.

XRP bulls retain a short-term advantage as long as the daily 20 EMA at $1.31 holds, with a resistance breakout potentially opening a retest of the $1.54 50-week EMA. Source: @ChartNerdTA via X

If that support remains intact and the price succeeds in reclaiming nearby resistance, attention could shift toward the 50-week EMA around $1.54.

The XRP price forecast 2026 therefore has a clearly defined technical path: maintaining support near the low $1.30s would preserve the possibility of a move toward the $1.54 weekly EMA, while a deeper breakdown would weaken the recovery setup.

The $1.54 level is particularly relevant because it represents a higher-timeframe moving-average barrier rather than simply an arbitrary price target. A sustained move above it would provide stronger evidence that the longer-term trend is improving.

Bearish Structure Still Threatens XRP

The bullish cycle thesis faces a near-term technical challenge from a separate four-hour analysis on TradingView.

The analyst identified a bearish break of structure at $1.3352 after the price broke its previous swing low. The subsequent recovery toward $1.3758 was described as a potential retest of the broken structure rather than confirmation of a new uptrend.

XRP just printed a bearish BoS six bars back on the 4H, cracking the last swing low at 1.3352 and flipping that level from support to overhead reference. Source: TradingView

The analysis places the EMA21 near $1.3655 and EMA55 around $1.3697. A sustained four-hour close above the EMA55, followed by a move through $1.3810, would improve the short-term structure.

From there, the analyst’s levels are $1.4045 and $1.4335, with the latter representing the previous swing high.

On the downside, losing $1.3655 would increase the risk of another move toward the lower part of the range around $1.3265. A four-hour close below that level would invalidate the recovery setup outlined in the analysis.

This creates a relatively clear technical framework for the XRP current price. Buyers need to regain the moving-average cluster and then challenge $1.40, while sellers retain control if the price repeatedly fails beneath those levels.

Binance XRP Reserves Hit 2024 Levels

On-chain data provides another factor that traders are monitoring.

CryptoQuant data shows that Binance’s average XRP reserves have fallen substantially since late 2025. The 30-day average reportedly declined from approximately 3.17 billion XRP in November 2025 to about 2.61 billion by September 1, 2026. That represents a reduction of roughly 551 million XRP, or 17.4%, according to data cited by Finbold.

Around 500 million XRP have left Binance, a relatively positive long-term signal that is unlikely to have a direct short-term impact on price. Source: CryptoQuant via X

The latest level is reportedly the lowest monthly average since February 2024. CryptoQuant contributor Darkfost described the development as a “relatively positive signal for XRP,” while emphasizing that its relevance is more long-term than an immediate price catalyst.

Falling exchange reserves can sometimes indicate that investors are moving tokens into private or long-term storage. However, reserve data alone cannot establish the reason for every withdrawal. Transfers between wallets, custody arrangements, and other operational movements can also affect exchange balances.

As a result, the decline should be viewed as a supporting on-chain indicator rather than direct evidence that a major XRP rally is imminent.

What the XRP Price Prediction Depends On

The current XRP price prediction ultimately comes down to whether the token can turn its recent consolidation into a confirmed breakout.

The first hurdle is the $1.36-$1.40 region. Reclaiming the short-term EMA cluster and establishing support above $1.40 would strengthen the bullish structure. The next technical areas would then come into view around $1.45 and $1.54-$1.55.

XRP price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

A move above $1.54 would be more significant because it would take XRP beyond the 50-week EMA highlighted by ChartNerdTA and into a higher-timeframe resistance area.

The alternative scenario remains straightforward. Failure to regain $1.36-$1.40 could leave XRP vulnerable to another test of $1.34, followed by the $1.32 area. A decisive break below approximately $1.28 would further weaken the argument that the latest decline represented the completion of a larger bottom.

For now, the 13-month cycle offers a bullish long-term interpretation, while the shorter-term chart continues to demand confirmation. XRP’s ability to reclaim $1.40 will therefore be important in determining whether the current consolidation becomes the foundation for a broader advance or another failed recovery attempt.

title: Saxo Bank’s H1 Profit Rises 18% as Client Assets Reach EUR 153B
summary:
Saxo Bank reported an
18% increase in net profit for the first half of 2026, as higher income and
client assets lifted the Danish investment bank to its strongest half-year
result on record.
Net profit reached EUR
87 million in the six months to June, up from EUR 73 million in H1 2025. Total
income ...
content:
2026-09-03T15:42:19.900+02:00

Thursday, 03/09/2026 | 13:42 GMT by Tareq Sikder

  • The client base reached 1.7M, adding around 300K clients over the previous year.
  • Trading activity benefited from equity market sentiment and higher oil and precious metals volatility.

Saxo Bank reported an 18% increase in net profit for the first half of 2026, as higher income and client assets lifted the Danish investment bank to its strongest half-year result on record.

Net profit reached EUR 87 million in the six months to June, up from EUR 73 million in H1 2025. Total income increased 12% year-on-year to EUR 375 million, compared with EUR 335 million a year earlier.

The result follows Saxo Bank’s 2025 financial performance, when the bank reported an adjusted net profit of EUR 120 million, alongside higher client activity and record client assets.

During 2025, J. Safra Sarasin Group agreed to acquire a majority stake in Saxo Bank from its existing shareholders. The transaction was completed in March this year.

Following the completion, Daniel Belfer was appointed CEO of Saxo Bank, while founder Kim Fournais became chairman of the board.

Saxo Client Assets Reach EUR 153B

Saxo said the H1 2026 result marked its “best half-year financial performance” in its history.

Client assets also increased during the period. Total client assets reached EUR 153 billion, up from EUR 118 billion in H1 2025. The number of clients rose to 1.7 million from 1.4 million.

Saxo attributed the performance partly to continued trading activity. It said market activity was supported by positive sentiment in equity markets and higher volatility in commodities, including oil and precious metals.

The bank also pointed to geopolitical tensions and elevated macroeconomic uncertainty during the first half of the year.

Compared with H1 2025, total income increased by EUR 40 million, while client assets rose by EUR 35 billion. The client base increased by around 300,000.

Saxo Focuses on Clients, AI

Saxo said it remained focused on expanding its global client and partner base during the period. It also continued to invest in its platforms and products.

The bank said further investment would focus on marketing, client offerings, artificial intelligence and other business-critical areas.

Belfer said the bank had delivered its “best half-year financial results in the bank’s history”. He also said Saxo had seen “solid growth in our client base”.

Saxo Adds Elite Tier in Singapore

In May 2026, Saxo Bank launched Saxo Elite, a premium service tier for accredited investors and active traders in Singapore. The offering includes personal relationship managers and access to Saxo’s trading desk and in-house strategists. It sits alongside the bank’s existing digital platform.

The launch followed other product additions in Singapore, including margin accounts and fractional shares. Saxo has used Singapore as the operational centre of its Asia-Pacific business since closing its Hong Kong and Shanghai offices in 2024.

title: DWF Labs Expands Global Regulatory Footprint with BVI Virtual Asset Service Provider Approval
summary: Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands, 3rd September 2026, Chainwire
content:
Skip to content

Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands, 3rd September 2026, Chainwire

Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands, September 3rd, 2026, Chainwire

DWF Labs, an established, market-tested investor and market maker built to strengthen digital asset market infrastructure at scale, today announced an expansion of its global regulatory footprint with a group entity granted Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) regulatory approval from the British Virgin Islands Financial Services Commission (BVI FSC).

Granted under the BVI’s Virtual Assets Service Providers Act 2022, the approval authorizes DWF Labs as a registered VASP, to provide the exchange of one or more forms of virtual assets, as well as to participate in, and provide financial services related to an issuer’s offer and/or sale of a virtual asset.

The approval enables institutional clients access to DWF Labs’ integrated OTC trading and market making capabilities, including spot trading across thousands of digital assets and stablecoins, through a regulated BVI entity. It also strengthens the company’s ability to deliver investment, incubation and ecosystem development services to support token issuers and digital asset projects on a global scale. 

The BVI has established itself as a leading jurisdiction for decentralized ledger deployments and structured real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The territory now represents nearly 10% of the global tokenization US treasuries market, with $1.5 billion in distributed value. BVI-domiciled entities also facilitate more than $1.2 billion in active, circulating stablecoins – figures underpinned by more than 24,700 stablecoin asset holders and weekly transfer volumes of $694.1 million. These figures (Source: rwa.xyz treasuries and stablecoins) reflect the strength of both the regulatory and market infrastructure DWF Labs is now positioned to operate within. 

Heng Lee, Managing Director and Partner at DWF Labs said, “The Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) approval from the British Virgin Islands Financial Services Commission (BVI FSC) is a key step in responsibly expanding and delivering DWF Labs’ regulated digital asset services to international institutional clients.” 

“As the digital asset market and industry continue to mature, and adoption increases, this addition to our regulatory framework will enable us to deliver a broader range of solutions, products, and services, while reinforcing our focus upon transparency and governance.”

DWF Labs will continue to expand its regulatory footprint across key global markets, supporting its international growth strategy and commitment to operating within robust regulatory frameworks.

About DWF Labs

Established in 2022, DWF Labs is an investor and market maker, focused on giving builders the capital, liquidity, expertise, and partnerships needed to take ideas from concept to scale. DWF Labs is among the world’s largest high-frequency digital asset trading organizations, active on more than 80 centralized and decentralized exchanges. The firm supports over 20% of CoinMarketCap’s Top 100 projects and 35% of its Top 1,000, and has worked with more than 1,000 blockchain companies across Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks, DeFi, gaming, AI, payments, infrastructure, and tokenization.

The firm’s work is organized across four business lines: Liquidity (institutional market making and liquidity provision), Investment and Incubation (strategic capital and token advisory for emerging projects), Ecosystem Development (go-to-market support), and OTC and Structured Markets (tailored trading solutions for institutions, funds, and protocol treasuries). DWF Labs also founded and incubated Falcon Finance, a synthetic dollar and universal collateralization protocol.

DWF Labs operates a globally distributed team on a 24/7/365 basis. 

For more information, visit www.dwf-labs.com, or follow DWF Labs on X, LinkedIn, and Telegram.

title: SUI Price Prediction: 6% Rebound and TD9 Signal Strengthen $0.85 Breakout Potential
summary: Sui (SUI) is showing early signs of recovery after a sharp decline through late August, with a roughly 6% daily rebound bringing renewed attention to its near-term technical structure.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: SUI

Sui (SUI) is showing early signs of recovery after a sharp decline through late August, with a roughly 6% daily rebound bringing renewed attention to its near-term technical structure.

The move has also coincided with a TD Sequential buy signal on the daily Sui chart, while traders are watching a descending trendline for confirmation of a broader recovery.

SUI price recently fell from around $0.87 to approximately $0.71 before stabilizing. Historical market data shows the token traded as low as $0.70 on September 2 before recovering toward the $0.77 area.

The rebound, however, has not yet confirmed a full trend reversal. Longer-term moving averages remain overhead, leaving the $0.79-$0.85 region as an important test for the SUI price prediction.

SUI Price Rebound Tests Key Resistance

The latest recovery has placed SUI back above several short-term moving averages. Based on the technical readings supplied for the daily chart, the 10-, 20-, 30-, and 50-period averages are clustered around the $0.72-$0.75 region, giving the recent bounce some short-term technical support.

SUI price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

At the same time, resistance is beginning to build around $0.78-$0.80. The 100-day exponential moving average is positioned near $0.78-$0.79, while the 200-day simple moving average is around $0.85.

That makes $0.85 more than a simple price target. It also represents a significantly longer-term technical barrier. A sustained move above that level would provide stronger evidence that SUI is moving beyond a short-term recovery.

TradingView’s SUI/USDT market page currently continues to show a sell-oriented technical rating across several timeframes, highlighting the gap between the recent rebound and the broader trend.

TD Sequential Signals Potential SUI Reversal

The rebound has gained additional attention after crypto analyst Ali Charts highlighted a TD Sequential buy signal on SUI’s daily chart.

The indicator produced a “9” count following a prolonged series of declining candles. TD Sequential signals are commonly used to identify potential exhaustion in an existing trend. They do not, by themselves, confirm that a new uptrend has begun.

The TD Sequential is flashing a buy signal on the $SUI daily chart, suggesting the recent correction could be nearing its end. Source: Ali Martinez via X

Ali Charts described the setup as suggesting that the recent correction could be nearing its end and pointed to a potential “1–4 daily candlestick rebound.”

The timing is notable because SUI had already moved into the $0.70-$0.72 support region before the signal appeared. That area has repeatedly attracted buyers in recent sessions.

Still, the TD Sequential reading should be treated as a reversal indicator rather than a standalone bullish confirmation. Price action, trading volume, and resistance levels will determine whether the signal develops into a sustained recovery.

SUI Price Prediction: $0.74 Trendline Holds the Key

A separate TradingView analysis by Elite_Forex_Signals_pro identifies a descending trendline near $0.74 as the immediate technical trigger.

The analysis places SUI inside a support zone around $0.7100-$0.7250 while the token tests the descending resistance line. According to the setup, a sustained one-hour close above approximately $0.74 would strengthen the breakout structure.

A sustained move above the descending trendline near $0.74 would confirm the breakout structure and strengthen the case for a move toward higher resistance levels. Source: Elite_Forex_Signals_pro on TradingView

The analyst identifies $0.79 as the first upside objective, followed by $0.85 as the next major resistance.

This creates a straightforward technical sequence. SUI first needs to maintain the recent rebound and clear the descending trendline. A move through $0.79 would then bring the 200-day moving average near $0.85 into focus.

Conversely, losing the $0.71 support area would weaken the setup and indicate that sellers remain in control.

Technical Indicators Remain Mixed

Despite the rebound, SUI’s broader technical picture remains divided.

The daily RSI is around 51.7, placing momentum close to neutral rather than in either overbought or oversold territory. This suggests the latest recovery has not yet pushed the market into an extreme momentum condition.

The MACD remains less convincing. The reported MACD level is around 0.007 against a signal line near 0.012, leaving the histogram slightly bearish despite showing signs of flattening.

The ADX reading near 24 also points to a market without a particularly strong directional trend. Meanwhile, Williams %R near -81 indicates that SUI recently reached relatively weak momentum conditions, which can sometimes accompany short-term rebounds.

Together, these indicators describe a market attempting to stabilize rather than one that has already confirmed a major trend reversal.

$0.70 Support Remains Critical

The downside structure is equally important for the SUI price prediction.

Immediate support is located around $0.72-$0.73, followed by the more significant $0.70-$0.71 region. The latter has become an important floor after SUI’s recent decline.

A decisive break below $0.70 could expose the next support zone around $0.65-$0.67, according to the technical structure outlined in the supplied analysis.

By contrast, maintaining prices above $0.72-$0.75 would keep the short-term recovery intact and allow bulls more time to challenge the $0.78-$0.80 resistance cluster.

The rise in crypto casinos has changed how traditional casinos operate. Games like dice are now simpler and very easily accessible. To play a dice casino game, you just need to target number, hit the roll button, and see if you win. But in traditional online casinos, you have to trust the site blindly.

You just hope the software isn’t secretly rigged against you. Crypto casinos changed everything with provably fair technology. This system uses cryptography to give you total proof. You do not need to trust the casino operator anymore. You can verify every single roll yourself in real time.

What Is Provably Fair Technology?

Provably fair technology is an algorithm that uses cryptographic functions to generate random game outcomes. You don’t need to blindly trust the casino to give you fair results.

In a provably fair dice game, neither the casino nor the player can alter the outcome once the round starts. The casino cannot lower your payout odds while your bet is active. Likewise, you cannot manipulate the system to force a win.

The Three Main Components: Seeds, Hashes, and Nonces

 

To understand how provably fair dice works, you only need to know three basic concepts:

1. The Server Seed

This is a random string of data created by the casino’s server. Before you roll, the casino hides the original server seed. Instead, it shows you an encrypted version known as a “hash”. This guarantees the casino cannot change the seed mid-game.

2. The Client Seed

It’s a random string that’s supplied by your web browser or device. This string can also be edited by hand. Since you are the one who supplies the client seed, the casino is not able to figure out what values will be used to compute the ending roll.

3. The Nonce

The nonce is a trivial counter. It will begin at zero at the start of a session and add one to it every time you place a bet. The nonce makes sure that each time you roll the dice, it is unique.

The SHA-256 Cryptographic Hash

A cryptographic hashing algorithm (SHA-256) acts like a digital fingerprint. It processes the server seed, client seed and nonce together. The output is a long string of letters and numbers. It converts directly into your dice roll (for example, a number between 0.00 and 99.99).

How a Provably Fair Dice Roll Work

Every time you click Roll, the following happens:

  • Server Seed Generation: The casino server generates a random Server Seed and provides you with its encrypted hash in advance.
  • Client Seed Generation: The device you use will send a client seed or you will enter your own phrase.
  • Roll Execution: Rolls are a combination of the server seed, client seed, and nonce. It uses SHA-256 to determine the dice number.
  • Server Seed Reveal: Once the end of your game round or session, the casino reveals the original server seed.
  • You verify the Fairness: You input the revealed server seed, your client seed, and the nonce into a separate hash calculator. If the hash is the same as the one you were shown prior to betting, the game is 100% fair.

title: ‘Crypto Capital of the World’: SEC Chair Expects Clarity Act to Pass This Month
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

‘Crypto Capital of the World’: SEC Chair Expects Clarity Act to Pass This Month
Securities and Exchange Commission Chair Paul Atkins has been pushing ahead with crypto regulation despite a delay in a vote on the Clarity Act. 
This post ‘Crypto Capital of the World’: SEC Chair Expec...
content:
Wall Street’s top regulator has said that he expects the long-awaited Clarity Act will get passed this month and the U.S. will be on track to be the “crypto capital of the world.” 

Speaking to Fox Business on Tuesday, Securities and Exchange Chairman Paul Atkins confirmed that the regulator was pushing ahead with rules to help the crypto industry. 

Pro-crypto lawmakers had hoped to pass the Clarity Act before Congress broke for August recess, but the vote slipped to September. The bill will establish a framework for distinguishing between digital assets that are securities, commodities or stablecoins. 

“The Clarity Act will be voted on in the Senate on the 15th of September,” Atkins said. “I anticipate and hope that it will be passed by the Senate and sent ultimately to the President’s desk for a signature.”

He added: “We’re changing the past approaches to try to update [rules], modernize them in the age of blockchain and crypto assets.”

Despite a vote on the Clarity Act being delayed, regulators like the SEC and Commodity Futures Trading Commission have said they will still proceed with trying to shape crypto policy. 

Last week, the SEC sent a proposal to the White House aiming to “clarify the framework for the custody of crypto assets” for investment advisers and companies. 

Despite being passed by the House of Representatives last year, the Clarity Act has been in a deadlock for most of this year after the banking lobby clashed with lawmakers and crypto businesses over whether platforms like Coinbase should be able to pay customers yield. 

Some lawmakers have sought to change wording in the bill regarding ethics, and a new bill started circulating in July. The draft bans government officials from promoting and making money from crypto. 

But other Democratic lawmakers said it still fell short; a number of pro-crypto Republicans accused Democrats of deliberately playing politics and delaying the bill. 

Mathew Di Salvo

Mathew is a reporter who's covered the space since 2019, reporting on everything from Salvadoran president Nayib Bukele's Bitcoin bet to crypto exchange FTX's bankruptcy.

title: Zcash (ZEC) Price Prediction: Can Privacy Coin Momentum Push ZEC Above Key $900 Resistance?
summary: Zcash (ZEC) is entering a critical phase after one of its strongest rallies in years, with the privacy-focused cryptocurrency consolidating near the $800 level after briefly climbing toward $900.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: ZEC

Zcash (ZEC) is entering a critical phase after one of its strongest rallies in years, with the privacy-focused cryptocurrency consolidating near the $800 level after briefly climbing toward $900.

The move has put the Zcash price back in focus as traders assess whether the latest rally can extend into fresh price discovery or whether a deeper pullback is needed first.

Technical indicators currently present a mixed but generally constructive picture. Moving averages remain strongly bullish across several timeframes, while oscillators are largely neutral. That combination suggests the broader trend remains firm, although short-term momentum has yet to provide a decisive signal.

Meanwhile, growing institutional access to ZEC has added another factor to the market. Grayscale’s Zcash investment vehicle, trading under the ticker ZCSH, provides investors with exposure to ZEC through a regulated security structure.

Zcash Price Consolidates After Sharp Rally

ZEC surged by nearly $400 within a week during its late-August rally, reaching levels not seen in roughly eight years. The advance followed a prolonged period of relatively subdued price action and pushed the ZEC price toward the $850-$900 region.

Zcash (ZEC) price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

The rally has since lost some momentum. A liquidity analysis places the price around $801 after a roughly 5% daily decline, with significant short-term liquidity concentrated between $780 and $790 on the downside.

On the upside, liquidity is clustered around $810-$815 and again near $840-$850. These zones could become important if ZEC attempts another breakout.

The derivatives market also shows elevated positioning. Futures volume was reported at approximately $3.55 billion against $312 million in spot volume, while open interest stood near $1.58 billion. Such a large derivatives presence can amplify price movements when traders are forced to close leveraged positions.

Can ZEC Break Above $900?

The key question for the current Zcash price prediction is whether ZEC can reclaim the recent highs around $888-$900.

A TradingView analysis by Wall_Street_Levels identifies $750 as an important monthly support level. The cryptocurrency recently tested that broader support structure and attracted buying interest.

Zcash rallied to a new all-time high before consolidating, with buyers defending the monthly support level. Source: Wall_Street_Levels on TradingView

If ZEC can regain resistance and establish a sustained move above the $900 region, the analysis identifies $971 as the next major upside reference.

That level would represent a fresh test of the market’s ability to extend the rally rather than simply recover from its recent consolidation.

However, traders are also watching the $750 area closely. A decisive breakdown could shift attention toward the $610-$650 historical support zone.

ZEC Technical Indicators Remain Constructive

The broader technical picture remains stronger than the short-term price action might suggest.

TradingView’s technical framework shows moving averages carrying a Strong Buy rating across higher timeframes. The 10-, 20-, 50-, 100- and 200-period averages are positioned below current price levels, indicating that the medium- and long-term trend remains upward.

ZEC’s heatmap shows concentrated upside liquidity at $810–$815 and $840–$850 after its 5% decline, with leverage reaching $1.74 million. Source: DXT via X

The Hull Moving Average and Volume Weighted Moving Average also support the bullish structure.

Oscillators, however, are more restrained. The Relative Strength Index is around 67, placing it close to overbought territory without reaching an extreme reading. Other momentum indicators remain largely neutral.

This divergence is important for the ZEC price forecast. Strong moving averages suggest the underlying trend has not deteriorated, while neutral oscillators indicate that momentum has cooled enough to allow consolidation.

$800-$833 Becomes Key Support

From a structural perspective, the $800-$833 area has emerged as an important zone for Zcash.

This region overlaps with previous consolidation levels and shorter-term moving averages. Holding above it would keep the current bullish structure relatively intact.

ZEC surged nearly $400 in a week to around $850, reaching an eight-year high in late August 2026 amid renewed bullish momentum. Source: @MarkETHreal via X

A deeper correction could bring the $750 area back into focus. Below that, the $610-$650 zone represents a more substantial historical demand area.

The liquidity data also highlights $780-$790 as a near-term level to watch. Losing that area could expose ZEC to a faster decline because of the relatively thin liquidity below it.

For traders monitoring the Zcash price today, the interaction between these support zones and overhead liquidity may provide a clearer signal than individual momentum indicators.

ETF Access Adds a New Market Catalyst

Institutional access has become an important part of the recent ZEC narrative.

Grayscale’s Zcash vehicle has provided investors with a regulated market-based route to gain exposure to ZEC without directly purchasing and safeguarding the cryptocurrency. Grayscale describes the product as an investment vehicle designed to track the value of ZEC held by the trust, after fees and expenses.

The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s filings also confirm that the regulator terminated its investigation or enforcement action involving the Zcash Foundation in January 2026.

That development does not guarantee future price appreciation, but it removes one regulatory uncertainty that had previously been associated with the Zcash ecosystem.

Grayscale has also recently highlighted Zcash as one of the major digital currencies within its research coverage, describing it as a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that uses zero-knowledge cryptography for shielded transactions.

Zcash Price Prediction: What Happens Next?

The current Zcash price prediction depends heavily on whether ZEC can defend its nearby support while rebuilding momentum toward $900.

A sustained move above $900 would strengthen the case for another leg higher, with $971 emerging as an important technical objective from the cited chart analysis.

Conversely, a failure to hold the $800-$833 region could increase selling pressure toward $780-$790 and potentially the broader $750 support.

The more significant bearish threshold sits below that level. A breakdown through $750 would expose the $610-$650 area identified by the technical analysis.

For now, the evidence points to a market in consolidation rather than a confirmed breakout. Moving averages continue to favor the longer-term trend, while elevated leverage and neutral oscillators suggest that volatility could remain high.

The immediate test for ZEC is therefore straightforward: can buyers regain control above $840-$850 and eventually challenge $900, or will the recent rally require a deeper reset before the next major move?

Notably, the three charts are not a single forecast, but rather three different periods of time. One setup is a continuation in the bull market, while another is a warning of a deeper pullback prior to buyers returning.

Chainlink Price Holds Near $11

The recovery was lost in the afternoon. Price subsequently made a couple of tests at $10.94 before trending back to $11.12. Sellers took off fast and moved LINK back in the direction of $11.05.

Bullish Pennant Keeps Higher Targets Open

The chart indicates that the LINK uptrend is starting from the $7.50 level and consolidating at the $11 level. The pennant has fewer moves in price, indicating a period of rest after the big move. Source: Lana Valentis Via X

title: Solana Price Prediction: SOL Weekly Reclaim and Falling Wedge Pattern Puts $120-$150 Back in Focus
summary: Solana (SOL) is testing the crucial $100 support region as a weekly falling wedge breakout and reduced token issuance bring the $120–$150 targets back into focus.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: SOL

Solana (SOL) is testing the crucial $100 support region as a weekly falling wedge breakout and reduced token issuance bring the $120–$150 targets back into focus.

Solana price is trading near $99.87 after falling 3.80% over the past 24 hours, leaving the token directly around one of its most important short-term technical areas. SOL traded between $98.44 and $103.50 during the session, while market capitalization remained near $58.43 billion.

The technical picture remains mixed but increasingly interesting. A large weekly falling wedge continues to compress price, while the recent move above a multi-month range has improved the broader market structure. At the same time, Solana’s community has approved a major reduction in future token issuance, adding a fundamental supply-side development to the current price setup.

SOL Tests the $100-$103 Reclaim Zone

The immediate technical battle is taking place between $100 and $103. Solana price briefly traded above this region before slipping back below it, showing that buyers have not yet fully established the breakout as support.

Solana slips below the $100–$103 reclaim zone after reaching $104.36, putting the recent breakout under pressure. Source: Ella via X

Crypto analyst Ella identified $100-$103 as the main reclaim zone after SOL opened near $103.03, traded as high as $104.36 and later fell towards $98.30. A daily close back above this region would weaken the recent breakdown attempt and improve the short-term structure.

Holding above $103 would bring $105 back into focus before attention shifts towards $110. Failure to recover $100, however, could keep price under pressure and expose support around $95-$97. For now, the market remains close enough to the breakout area that confirmation on either side could quickly determine the next short-term move.

Weekly Falling Wedge Targeting $140-$150 Region

Solana’s weekly chart shows a broad falling wedge that has developed throughout the decline from the 2025 highs. Price has gradually compressed between descending support and resistance, with the latest rally pushing SOL towards the upper boundary of the structure.

Famous analyst CryptoJack highlighted the formation as a possible larger reversal setup. Falling wedges often attract bullish attention when price begins testing the upper trendline, but confirmation still requires a decisive weekly breakout rather than simply trading close to resistance.

Solana tests the upper boundary of a weekly falling wedge, with a confirmed breakout potentially opening the way towards $120–$150. Source: CryptoJack via X

The upper part of the structure currently sits around the $100-$110 region. A clean breakout could shift attention first towards $120 before the market begins considering the broader $140-$150 area.

The lower boundary remains much deeper around $60-$70. That means the setup is not risk-free, but the improving higher-timeframe structure suggests the wedge deserves attention as Solana price attempts to establish a more durable recovery.

SOL Sees Weekly Range Breakout

Another important development is Solana’s breakout from the broad range that dominated much of 2026. Price spent several months trading between roughly $60-$65 support and resistance around $95-$100 before finally pushing through the upper boundary. Mayne’s chart shows Solana price testing this former resistance area after the breakout. This makes the current region especially important because successful range breakouts often require former resistance to become support before another expansion begins.

Solana breaks above its multi-month range and retests the $95–$100 resistance zone as potential new support. Source: Mayne via X

If the $95-$100 area holds, the breakout would remain technically intact and could eventually support a move towards $120. A sustained return below the former range ceiling would weaken the setup and increase the possibility that SOL Solana price spends more time consolidating.

The current retest is therefore more significant than a normal short-term pullback. It may determine whether the recent move represents a genuine structural shift or another failed attempt above resistance.

Solana Changing Supply Outlook

Solana’s longer-term supply outlook has also changed following a major governance decision. The community voted to double the network’s disinflation rate to 30%, accelerating the pace at which new SOL issuance declines. The proposal reportedly passed the required 66.67% threshold during the final hour of voting.

Solana’s Double Disinflation proposal secures 67% support, accelerating the reduction in new SOL issuance. Source: CoinDesk via X

The adjustment is expected to reduce projected issuance by approximately 18.9 million SOL over the next six years, valued around $1.47 billion at the quoted market price. This does not directly determine SOL’s short-term price, but it changes the longer-term supply profile. If network demand continues expanding while token issuance falls faster, the reduced inflation schedule could become increasingly relevant during stronger market cycles.

For the broader Solana price prediction, this creates a fundamental backdrop that may support the technical recovery if price can continue building above the $100 region.

Momentum Remains Positive but Needs Confirmation

Solana’s recent recovery has been strong enough to shift short-term momentum significantly, but the market is now entering an area where confirmation matters more than the initial bounce.

The move from the summer lows towards $100 has already produced a substantial recovery, meaning some consolidation around the breakout zone would not be unusual. Solana price now needs to show that buyers are willing to defend higher levels instead of allowing SOL price to fall back into its previous trading range.

A daily reclaim of $103 would be the first positive signal. The next resistance area sits around $105-$110, followed by $120. Above $120, the higher-timeframe setup becomes more interesting because the falling wedge breakout and range breakout would begin reinforcing each other.

Final Thoughts: Can SOL Turn the $100 Area Into a New Base?

Solana price is now attempting to convert one of its former resistance zones into support after a strong recovery from the summer lows. The weekly falling wedge remains constructive, the multi-month range breakout has improved the broader structure, and the reduction in future token issuance adds an important fundamental development. However, none of these factors removes the need for price confirmation around $100-$103.

Solana price trades at $106.49, down 0.19% in the last 24 hours. Source: SOL price via Brave New Coin

A successful reclaim would put $105-$110 back in play before attention shifts towards $120. Beyond that, a confirmed weekly breakout could expand the Solana price prediction towards $140-$150.

Failure to regain $100 would keep the market vulnerable to a deeper retest of $95, $90 and potentially the lower parts of the previous range. For now, the $100-$103 region remains the clearest technical test. If buyers can turn it into support, the broader recovery has room to extend. If not, SOL price may need more consolidation before another sustained move higher.

title: Mexican Billionaire Ricardo Salinas Tells People To Escape Fiat Inflation With Bitcoin
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Mexican Billionaire Ricardo Salinas Tells People To Escape Fiat Inflation With Bitcoin
The Mexican business magnate continues to tell people to escape what he calls the "fiat fraud." 
This post Mexican Billionaire Ricardo Salinas Tells People To Escape Fiat Inflation With Bitcoin f...
content:
Mexican billionaire Ricardo Salinas is at it again. 

This time, the third richest man in Mexico told his followers that “fiat inflation is a hidden tax,” and the way to hedge against it was to buy bitcoin. 

Salinas, the former chairman of home appliance and electronics retailer Grupo Elektra and Banco Azteca founder, told his followers to opt out and start protecting their savings. 

“Bitcoin changes one fundamental rule: no one can print more just because they want to,” Salinas said in a video on X on Monday. 

“While you have to work to earn more money, the system can simply create more of it. Don’t be fooled: learn, protect your savings, and defend your freedom, buy bitcoin and hold it.” 

It’s not the first time Salinas has told his followers to be aware of government monetary policy. 

The billionaire posts on X almost daily to millions of followers, and criticizing central bank money creation is one of his recurring themes, appearing in tweets, interviews, conference keynotes, and video messages. 

In recent years, the entrepreneur has stepped up his criticisms of governments — and his praises of bitcoin. Earlier this year admitted he had increased his allocation in the asset from 10% to 70% of his portfolio. 

Salinas’ bitcoin enthusiasm all stems from central bank monetary policy. Speaking at Bitcoin 2022, Salinas described traditional money as “the fiat fraud.”

“What they are doing is printing money out of thin air, and then making fake purchases,” he said of the Federal Reserve. 

The business magnate has also talked about his success in “orange pilling” his friends and family. 

“I convinced my wife to mortgage the house that she has and take a loan to buy bitcoin,” he once boasted in an interview. 

Mathew Di Salvo

Mathew is a reporter who's covered the space since 2019, reporting on everything from Salvadoran president Nayib Bukele's Bitcoin bet to crypto exchange FTX's bankruptcy.

content:
MEXC is available in more than 170 countries and regions, but you cannot use it from the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and several other blocked locations. The main MEXC restricted countries also include North Korea, Cuba, Sudan, Iran, Mainland China, Singapore, Hong Kong, Kazakhstan, and Russia-controlled parts of Ukraine.

This guide is for crypto traders and investors who need to confirm whether MEXC is accessible in their country, understand why the exchange blocks certain regions, and find legal alternatives if they live in a restricted market. We will cover MEXC restricted and supported countries, whether you can use MEXC in the USA or UK, VPN risks, futures availability, KYC rules, and regulatory compliance so you can avoid account issues, terms violations, and unnecessary trading risk.

What Are the MEXC Restricted Countries?

The MEXC restricted countries are North Korea, Cuba, Sudan, Iran, Mainland China, Singapore, the United States, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Kazakhstan, Canada, and the Russian-controlled regions of Ukraine; Kazakhstan was added in May 2025. Those Ukrainian regions currently include Crimea, Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, and Sevastopol.

MEXC also blocks countries and territories under EU or US Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctions. Currently, the FATF list names North Korea, Iran, and Myanmar.


Also, MEXC suspended trading, deposits, and other digital asset trading services from Indian addresses recently while working on FIU-IND registration. India is not a permanently prohibited country, but the exchange remains unavailable during the suspension.

Beyond the full ban list, a few countries face a smaller, app-store-only limit as well. The iOS app is currently pulled in India, Japan, and South Korea, and the Android version is missing in those same places plus Indonesia. You can still reach the MEXC site through a web browser in most cases, but that does not guarantee eligibility for all services in that country or territory, and fresh app downloads are off the table.

***Note:***MEXC has officially not marked Europe as a restricted jurisdiction, but it does hold a Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) license. So, its availability in Europe is uncertain, and obviously not legal.

Why Does MEXC Not Work in These Restricted Countries?

MEXC does not work in these countries for three main reasons: sanctions law, missing licenses, and direct regulator bans, and users should be aware that different jurisdictions impose different access rules.

You see, countries like North Korea, Iran, Cuba, Sudan, and parts of Ukraine are under heavy sanctions from the US, the EU, and the FATF. So, because of these strict international rules, MEXC cannot legally offer services there at all.

Now, missing licenses explain the next group. The United States demands federal derivatives registration plus state money transmitter licenses. Singapore also requires a “Payment Services Act” license from its central bank, and Hong Kong also runs a strict licensing regime and added MEXC to its Suspicious Virtual Asset Trading Platforms Alert List. MEXC holds none of these approvals, so it obviously shuts the door instead of risking a fine.

In other spots, local authorities step in. So, for example, the UK blocked access after the FCA placed MEXC on its official warning list. Kazakhstan did something similar by requiring all crypto exchanges to be registered with its own financial center.

Can I Use MEXC in the USA?

No, you cannot use MEXC in the USA, and this is not a small technicality. The United States sits right at the top of the prohibited list, and MEXC has never built a US entity or gone after the approvals that would allow one.

You see, real access in the US would need CFTC registration for any derivatives product, a FinCEN Money Services Business filing, and even a separate money transmitter license in nearly every single state. MEXC holds none of these, and users in America are blocked because the exchange lacks the required approvals there. Currently, the exchange uses automatic system checks to block IP addresses coming from American internet service providers.

Is MEXC Blocked in the UK?

Yes, MEXC is fully blocked in the United Kingdom, and the ban got a lot stronger this year. Previously, access used to be limited to app-store removals on iOS and Android, but today, the Financial Conduct Authority placed MEXC Global Ltd on its official Warning List and called the firm unauthorized.

Hence, the MEXC exchange names the United Kingdom as a prohibited jurisdiction and does not accept UK registrations or trade applications. 

Can I Use a VPN to Access MEXC in These Restricted Countries?

No, you must not use a VPN to get around MEXC’s country block because it actually breaks the platform’s own “Terms of Service”. Basically, MEXC checks IP addresses and account activity, and it can freeze funds or ask for extra verification the moment it finds a difference between your stated location and your real one. MEXC reserves the right to restrict access or terminate accounts that break its location rules or provide false residency information.

Plus, the “User Agreement” also requires you to report any move into a blocked country. So, even a false home address claim gives MEXC the full right to close your account and close any open positions without warning.

Sure, a VPN might get you past the sign-up page for a while, but it does nothing to protect you once something goes wrong. MEXC does have security measures like two-factor authentication for account security and cold storage to protect user assets, but those safeguards do not override its location rules. A weak or unstable connection can also trigger login, verification, or trading issues when you try to bypass regional blocks, even if you think your setup is secure. Traders should do their own research before risking funds on any exchange-access workaround. You get no dispute process, no regulator to call, and even no guarantee your withdrawal ever clears. Honestly, using a VPN here is not worth the risk when solid, regulated exchanges exist for almost every restricted region. You can check out our full MEXC review for more info about the exchange.

What Are the Best MEXC Alternatives in the US and Canada?

The best MEXC alternatives in the US and Canada are Coinbase and Crypto.com.

  • Coinbase: Coinbase operates with full regulatory approval in both these countries. It holds money transmitter licenses in all 50 US states and is registered as a Restricted Dealer with the Canadian Securities Administrators (CSA) under CIRO. You get direct bank connectivity with US ACH and Canadian Interac e-Transfers for instant deposits.
  • Crypto.com: Crypto.com is another top MEXC alternative that holds official Money Services Business (MSB) registrations with FinCEN in the United States and FINTRAC in Canada. You can fund your account easily using US wire transfers or Canadian Interac e-Transfers with zero deposit fees.

What Are the Best MEXC Alternatives in Europe?

The best regulated MEXC alternatives for users in the European Economic Area (EEA) are Bybit EU and OKX Europe.

  • Bybit EU: Bybit is available through regulated local partnerships. This includes its registration with the Dutch Central Bank (DNB) via SATOS and its MiCA-compliant framework in the European Union. You can deposit Euros directly using SEPA and SEPA Instant with zero to low bank transfer fees.
  • OKX: It is another strong MEXC replacement in the EEA because its European exchange operates under a full MiCA license rather than an older temporary VASP registration. You can buy and trade more than 350 crypto pairs directly with Euros through SEPA bank transfers and card rails.

What Are the Best MEXC Alternatives in Russia?

The best practical MEXC alternatives currently available to many Russian users are Bybit and Bitget.

  • Bybit: It is actually the most popular international exchange for Russian users because it offers easy Ruble (RUB) peer-to-peer (P2P) trading channels. You can trade with zero P2P platform fees across major Russian payment methods, including SBP (Faster Payments System) and local bank cards.
  • Bitget: This is another MEXC alternative available to Russian users, especially if you want access to spot, futures, trading bots, and copy-trading style tools on one platform. You can fund your account directly with rubles through card payments (via Advcash) or through P2P trading with over 100 payment methods.

Note: No foreign exchange holds an “official license” to operate in Russia. So, here, “best alternative” in Russia really means: which platform is the most reliable, widely used, and easiest to access without breaking any rules.

What Are the Best MEXC Alternatives in Asia (Japan) and the Middle East (Iran)?

The best MEXC alternative in Japan is Binance Japan, but Iran does not currently have a licensed major international exchange. Also, recently, the US Treasury even sanctioned Iran’s own local exchanges (Nobitex, Wallex, Bitpin, and Ramzinex) as part of the ongoing conflict with Iran, so this is an active, serious legal situation.

  • Binance: For Japan, Binance operates through Binance Japan Inc. It is registered with Japan’s Financial Services Agency as a proper Crypto Asset Exchange Service Provider. Actually, this came after Binance bought a locally licensed Japanese exchange (Sakura Exchange BitCoin). Now, for the Middle East, Binance also holds a full VARA Virtual Asset Service Provider license for retail trading in Dubai, UAE. Well, this makes it one of the very few exchanges licensed for both regions.
  • OKX: OKX is the second strong pick for the Middle East. Its Dubai entity, OKX Middle East, holds a VARA (Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority) license. Hence, this allows it to legally offer AED deposits, withdrawals, and spot trading pairs to UAE residents.

What Are the MEXC Supported Countries?

MEXC supports more than 170 countries once you take the prohibited list out of the picture, and it claims over 40 million users while offering access to over 2,300 cryptocurrencies and other digital assets.

Now, the most common countries not named in the main prohibition list include Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Turkey, Georgia, Vietnam, Thailand, Malaysia, Taiwan, Australia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, and South Africa. But again, this does not mean that every feature has local regulatory approval, as regulatory restrictions can still limit futures, fiat services, or app access in some countries, and availability can still vary across several countries and each market because of local rules. Even MEXC does not hold a single license. Its operations span multiple jurisdictions, but those rules still limit what investors can access. It remains unlicensed everywhere it operates.

Can We Use MEXC Futures Trading in These Allowed Countries?

Yes, you can use MEXC futures trading only in an allowed country where your local law also permits crypto derivatives. It currently offers up to 200x leverage for its perpetual futures contracts, with a standard trading cost of 0.04% taker fees. By contrast, the spot market offers 0% maker fees. Does MEXC Require KYC in These Available Countries?

MEXC does not follow the exact same KYC rules in every single country. But you should now expect identity checks for most regular trading and withdrawal features. You may also need to create an account before seeing country-specific verification limits and available services. Mainly, local laws decide what an unverified user can do and which features you can gain access to, so the exact limits depend on your country, the services offered on the site, and the documents requested during verification.

The platform offers two main personal verification tiers:

  • Primary KYC: It unlocks standard spot and futures trading, unlimited crypto deposits, P2P trading, and lets you withdraw up to 80 BTC per day. Customers must submit identity documents to access certain features for trading digital assets. You just need a valid government-issued ID like a passport, national ID card, driver’s license, or residence permit.
  • Advanced KYC: This one increases your daily crypto withdrawal limit to 200 BTC and allows you to buy or sell up to $20,000 in fiat currency each day. Here, you must complete a quick facial verification, and you may be asked to use two devices during checks or login protection.

Does MEXC Meet Regulatory Compliance Requirements?

No, MEXC does not meet full regulatory compliance in most of its major markets, and the record backs that up clearly. MEXC’s regulatory issues can affect customers through service suspensions, account-freezing events, or feature limits in restricted jurisdictions. Estonia canceled the MTR license for MEXC back in late 2023 because the platform failed anti-money laundering and compliance checks. Even though MEXC Estonia tried to appeal the decision, the license remains inactive today.

In Australia, the exchange never received a direct registration from AUSTRAC or official approval from ASIC. Plus, in Dubai, the financial regulator VARA issued an official public alert telling people to stay away from the platform. Now, on top of that, Germany’s regulator BaFin also put out a warning against MEXC for offering crypto custody services without getting the right government license first. MEXC’s business operations span multiple jurisdictions, but that does not remove the regulatory risk users take when trading digital assets, and unsupported activity such as games of chance can draw extra scrutiny under platform rules. Right now, MEXC runs mainly through its Seychelles entity. It’s a jurisdiction with far lighter rules than the US, UK, or EU.
